dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-colored perimeters with jagged edges. Sharp gradient transition from dark exterior backgrounds to high-intensity white/grey boundaries, often containing a darker interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid high-intensity white pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily situated in the interstitial spaces between the larger macro-annuli on the lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent macro-annuli in the upper dorsal-lateral quadrant form an asymmetrical, scalene quadrilateral.

other_distinctive_markers: Complex nested branching of three interconnected light rings located on the upper-mid section of the visible torso.
